technical.summary: AMGN shows strong trend structure with ADX confirmation and bullish moving average alignment, but RSI overbought conditions and lack of fresh momentum crossovers limit swing entry conviction in neutral sector environment.

fundamental.summary: No actionable smart money signals detected; insider/institutional activity absent, government contracts and lobbying data unavailable, with elevated earnings risk in 76 days.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; broad market neutral sentiment with slight bearish bias (47% bearish vs 25% bullish) offers modest contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and small-value congressional sales limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (268) indicates extreme market fear, and earnings in 76 days presents binary event risk; only DXY tailwind provides minor offset.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong ADX trend confirmation with price above major moving averages provides structural bullish setup, supported by DXY tailwind and modest contrarian sentiment opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels), high earnings risk in 76 days, RSI overbought without fresh momentum crossovers, and complete absence of smart money/insider conviction create unacceptable risk-reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical trend structure is sound with ADX confirmation and bullish MA alignment, but macro environment is severely hostile with inverted yield curve and VIX crisis levels creating unacceptable risk asymmetry for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Binary earnings event in 76 days combined with extreme market fear (VIX 268) and recession-signaling yield curve inversion creates tail risk that outweighs technical setup strength.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Existing AMGN position plus 33 open Health Care positions (10% of portfolio) already create sector concentration; adding to this exposure during macro crisis and earnings proximity violates prudent risk management.
